How it works

Four steps, in order — from your first ride to your ₹500 payout.

01

Make a reel about FREERIDE

Explain what the code unlocks — a free first auto ride — and how to apply it.

02

03

Post it public

Publish on Instagram or YouTube Shorts, tag @rapido, keep it visible.

04

Cross 1,000 views

Once your reel hits 1,000 genuine views, submit the link below.

Eligibility at a glance

  • Open to participants based in India only.
  • Follow Rapido's official Instagram, Facebook, and X handles, and have the Rapido app installed.
  • Reel must clearly show or say the code FREERIDE and explain what it unlocks.
  • Campaign hashtags are compulsory in your reel caption.
  • No limit on entries per person — but only one entry is accepted per day.
  • Multiple accounts used to enter will make you ineligible.

Best practices

Reels that convert borrow from the same playbook. A few things that help yours perform.

✓Hook in the first 3 seconds — show the ride or say "first ride free" right away.
✓Say FREERIDE out loud or show it on-screen — don't bury it in a small caption.
✓Keep it real — a natural reaction beats a scripted read.
✓Use trending audio or formats relevant to your niche.
✓Put the campaign hashtag in your caption, not buried in the comments.
✓Post when your audience is most active — check your own insights.
